name: Dog
overview: Scripture uses the image of dogs to illustrate folly, spiritual blindness, and greed. Proverbs 26:11 compares a fool to a dog returning to its vomit, highlighting the repetitive nature of foolishness. Isaiah 56 describes watchmen as 'dumb dogs' who are blind and unable to fulfill their duty, emphasizing their spiritual ignorance and failure. Additionally, these watchmen are likened to greedy dogs who are never satisfied, focusing on their selfishness rather than their responsibility as shepherds.
